blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Kayla Sanchez missed the podium again, placing fourth in the women’s 50-meter freestyle at the Asian Games 2026 swimming competition Thursday at Tokyo Aquatics Center. After prioritizing her recovery and skipping her events Wednesday, Sanchez still fell short of a medal, clocking 24.75 seconds The two-time Olympic medalist finished 0.29 seconds behind bronze medalist Yujie Cheng of China, who nabbed the bronze with 24.46 seconds. Qingfeng Wu of China posted a new Asian Games record of 23.98 seconds for the gold medal, while Siobhan Haughey of Hong Kong clocked 24.32 seconds for the silver.
